items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: He worked with me up in Syracuse a few months ago. He was with my quartet.

ctx.x: And he really uses the voice as an instrument along with his bass.

That is correct. That is correct. He worked with me up in Syracuse a few months ago. He was with my quartet. And I'd sing a number like 'Basin Street Blues' and he would, on the last note I'd hold a note out. He'd bow one bass. arco we call it, bow, we'd bow one note, sing another note and I'd sing another note. We had three-part harmony there. But I didn't ask him to do it. He just did it. You see, this is what I'm talking about. This shows his musicianship and his empathy.
What is that word you just used I don't know that technical term?
